C1032.title: Chizhou Prosecutors Handle Blockchain Project Backdoor Virtual Currency Theft Case
C1032.summary: According to the Supreme People's Procuratorate, Li and others developed a blockchain virtual currency investment project with a backdoor function, induced investors to stake virtual currency, and then transferred and cashed it out, causing losses of 38 million yuan to multiple investors. After a victim reported the case in October 2021, Chizhou police investigated and asked the Guichi District Procuratorate to intervene early; the Chizhou Intermediate People's Court later dismissed the appeals and upheld the original judgment.
